title: Gauge pins need current reading for flood severity colors
description: Map pins for gauges should show flood severity colors and icons (Major/Moderate/Minor/Action/No Flooding), but this requires knowing the current water level for each gauge. Currently, readings are only fetched on demand when a gauge detail panel is opened (useLocationDetail composable). To color pins on the map, the latest reading for each gauge needs to be available at the list level. Options: (1) fetch latest reading per gauge in useLocations, (2) add a batch endpoint to the API that returns latest readings for all gauges, (3) include latest reading in the /location/all response. Once readings are available, compare gaugeHeight against actionStage/minorStage/moderateStage/majorStage thresholds to determine the category, then set colorTheme and icon accordingly (same pattern as the FloodSeverityColors story in map-core).

title: Camera pin hover is gray instead of light blue
description: Camera pins use `color="#3053B6"` override on MapIconTextPin. Hover state shows generic gray instead of a light blue tint. Blocked by map-core-cq0 — once map-core fixes the color override hover background, this will resolve automatically (or we'll need to pass a hoverColor prop depending on the solution).
